caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a dark, possibly black, cushioned seat. The chair has a carved backrest featuring a decorative medallion at the top center, with an ornate, curvilinear central splat extending downward. The arms of the chair are elegantly curved, matching the overall ornate design. The legs of the chair are cabriole style, featuring carved detailing, and the front seat rail displays a shell-like decorative carving in the center. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, indicating a polished, possibly mahogany surface. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a simple line sketch showing the basic structure of the chair in a faint, box-like outline. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or patterns present. The artist's signature and date appear in small, cursive writing in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Armchair
